name: awesome-statusline-mod
description: Awesome Statusline as a mod: the same 15 presets drawn in a band above the prompt, so it also shows in the Claude desktop app. Beta, macOS / Linux.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Size (xsmall small medium large xlarge), optionally with -plain (no emoji) or -simple (text only)

terminal.title: In the terminal
terminal.description: auto: hidden while a statusLine is set, since the terminal already shows one; show; hide. The desktop app always shows the band.
